title: Shop Demo · JMeter 实时压测看板

targets.query:
from(bucket: "jmeter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "jmeter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["application"] =~ /^${application}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["transaction"] =~ /^${transaction}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "startedThreads" or r["_field"] == "endedThreads")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "threads")

from(bucket: "jmeter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "jmeter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["application"] =~ /^${application}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["transaction"] =~ /^${transaction}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "tps")

from(bucket: "jmeter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "jmeter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["application"] =~ /^${application}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["transaction"] =~ /^${transaction}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pct95.0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "p95")

from(bucket: "jmeter")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "jmeter")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["application"] =~ /^${application}$/)
